evidence.reason: The test mutates both preservation conditions in the same fixture: owned alive=False and unrelated after.alive=False (lines 669-670), then only asserts the combined refusal check is false. If build_checks drops either the owned-process check or the unrelated-process check, the other mutation still makes drain_alive_refused false, so this test passes and cannot detect loss of one required preservation check. Splitting each mutation into its own subtest with a fresh phases() fixture is a small, ordinary test-correctness fix; it does not require an owner decision.
